info.title: ACM Bidding Platform API
info.description: Backend for the ACM bidding platform: game teams bid code time on prompts, judges score the results.

503.description: Database unavailable, initializing, or missing migrations

get.summary: Persisted bid history across all rounds and prompts

parameters.name: round
parameters.description: Return only this prompt round; legacy history is projected by prompt without rewriting stored records.

get.summary: Current prompt, countdown, bids and configured limits

post.summary: Place or replace a team bid

get.summary: Team assignment and score for reload/reconnect recovery

200.description: Assignment and score, each nullable; decimal fields are JSON numbers

get.summary: Authoritative server clock and active bidding timer state

200.description: Server clock and bidding timer snapshot

serverTime.description: Current server timestamp in epoch ms

get.summary: NTP / Cristian clock sync ping (GET with query param t0)

200.description: Sync response echoing clientTime and server timestamps

post.summary: NTP / Cristian clock sync ping (POST with JSON body)

200.description: Sync response echoing clientTime and server timestamps
Token identity (team or admin depending on role)

put.description: `teamName`, `password`, and `isActive` are all optional, but at least one must be provided.

delete.summary: Remove team (also removes its bids, assignment, and score)

patch.description: Deactivated teams are rejected with 403 at login.

post.description: `displayOrder` is optional and auto-assigns `max + 1` when omitted.

put.description: `title`, `description`, and `displayOrder` are all optional, but at least one must be provided.

delete.summary: Remove prompt (also removes its bids and assignments)

post.description: Round N identifies Prompt N. Starts the next sequential round; all rounds use the same multiplier curve.
Freezes bidding countdown and sets game status to paused.
Resumes the paused timer and restores game status to bidding.
Adds extraSeconds to the active or paused timer.

post.summary: Manually open the next prompt round
post.description: Closes the current round if needed, then opens the next prompt as Round N+1. Timer expiry never advances prompts. Completed results stay visible until this action.
Awards the current round and keeps its prompt, bids and results visible. Does not open another prompt.

post.summary: Rerun a round resetting its winners to null
post.description: Reruns a round, assigning null to all winners of that round, deleting their assignments, scores, and bids, and restarting the bidding timer for the prompt.

post.summary: Submit or update judge score for a team
post.description: Calculates final score = judgeScore * multiplier from team assignment.

get.description: Returns all teams ranked by finalScore descending.

post.description: Nuclear option: wipes bids, assignments, scores, and resets game config to waiting.

put.description: Updates game configuration. Only allowed when round is not actively in progress.

TeamAuth.description: Team token issued (also returned as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` response header)

AdminAuth.description: Admin token issued (also returned as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` response header)

BiddingSnapshot.description: One prompt per round in captured display order. Expiry closes the current round and retains its prompt, bids and winners; only admin Next opens another prompt.

timerStreamId.description: Identifies the server process owning the central countdown.

timerSequence.description: Increasing snapshot order within a timer stream, independent of wall-clock changes.

serverMonotonicTime.description: Server elapsed milliseconds used to age delayed snapshots after a socket time-sync exchange.

completedRound.description: Previous round outcome included when Next opens another prompt

timerId.description: Viewed bidding session; send to prevent stale submissions.
Reject a command if its viewed timer session is no longer active.

RoundStartInput.description: Start the next sequential prompt round; Round N opens Prompt N. Completed rounds cannot be replayed and future rounds cannot be skipped.
